title: 1-day vs 5-day moving-average crossover on the dollar majors (Pukthuanthong-Le, Levich, Thomas)
source: Pukthuanthong-Le, Levich & Thomas (2006), Do Foreign Exchange Markets Still Trend?, NYU Stern working paper FIN-06-030 (draft 13 Nov 2006)
why: The paper's second rule: the 1-day average against the 5-day average, long above and short below, held until the signal changes. It is the fastest of the paper's three rules and is kept as its own spec so the 5/20 rule is not diluted. The paper reports the same decline in the majors after 1995 (Exhibit 1), so a fail is the expected result. Gold and the yen crosses are left out, as the paper does not test them.
